enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Shift legs. Remain asleep. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Open eyes at 06:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a morning shower and completing hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Pick up pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Pick up plate. Put eggs on plate. Pick up bread. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Wait for toast. Take toast out. Put toast on plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Pick up plate. Put plate in sink. Turn off stove. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Pick out shirt. Pick out pants. Pick out socks. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to desk. Pick up bag. Open bag. Put laptop in bag. Put charger in bag. Put notebook in bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nursing station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working the morning shift, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to nursing station. Pick up patient list. Review notes. Walk to patient room 1. Knock. Enter. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Adjust IV. Talk to patient. Walk to room 2. Check blood pressure. Check temperature. Record data. Walk to room 3. Administer medication. Walk to room 4. Change dressing. Walk to room 5. Assist patient with mobility. Walk to nursing station. Update records. Answer phone. Talk to doctor. Walk to room 6. Check oxygen levels. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to nursing station.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay at cashier. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Clear tray. Walk to restroom. Wash hands. Walk back to nursing station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working the afternoon shift, updating patient records and handing over cases
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to computer. Log in. Open patient records. Type notes. Update medication list. Print documents. Walk to patient room 1. Discuss discharge plan. Walk to patient room 2. Talk to family. Walk to nursing station. Answer phone. Walk to patient room 3. Check vital signs. Record data. Walk to patient room 4. Administer medication. Walk to nursing station. Review handover notes. Talk to incoming nurse. Hand over cases. Walk to locker room. Change out of scrubs. Walk to exit.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to home. Enter home. Remove shoes. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Put plate in sink. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Put remote on coffee table.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a hot shower after the evening peak period
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for personal browsing and leisure
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Open browser. Type website address. Scroll page. Click links. Read articles. Watch videos. Type email. Send email. Close browser. Shut down computer. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV in bed to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Lie on bed. Pull blanket over body. Change channels. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Put remote on nightstand.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and completing evening hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.
Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Pull blanket. Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Remain asleep.
